Method of Attack: Embedded LNK file runs a Powershell script that installs the 9002 remote access trojan, allowing attackers full access to the infected machine
Impacted Systems: Machines infected by the 9002 remote access trojan
Attack Vector: Emails with malicious attachments containing embedded LNK files
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject 'Wanna see the Game of Thrones in advance?'
Malicious documents with embedded LNK files
